content: fpm (MikeLankamp, MIT, header-only, C++11) v1.1.0 tag 2021 but repo pushed 2026-03; fixed<Base,Intermediate,FractionBits,Rounding>: static_asserts allow int64_t base with __int128 intermediate for Q32.32; sqrt is integer base-2 digit-by-digit; trig/exp/log are polynomial with compile-time constants, no float/double in math.hpp; float conversions use floating arithmetic (avoid on the authoritative path). CNL v1.1.2 (2020, experimental SG14, pushed 2024) is broader but lacks most math functions.
